name: Google Programmable Search
label: Google Programmable Search
description: Google Programmable Search official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: cse_list, cse_siterestrict. Docs: https://developers.google.com/custom-search/v1/overview. Google APIs Terms. Closed to new CSE JSON customers; existing pricing until 2027-01-01. Requires Programmable Search Engine id (cx). Do not scrape google.com/search. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Programmable Search request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"cse_list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: cse_list | cse_siterestrict. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'cse_list'.

schema.label: cx
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `cx` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lr
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lr` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: num
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `num` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: safe
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `safe` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: searchType
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `searchType` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: start
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `start` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: Geolocation
schema.description: CSE gl — 2-letter country to boost. cse_list / cse_siterestrict. Example: us.

schema.label: Country restrict
schema.description: CSE cr, e.g. countryUS. cse_list / cse_siterestrict.

schema.label: Date restrict
schema.description: CSE dateRestrict. EXACT form: d[N] | w[N] | m[N] | y[N]. Example: m3.

schema.label: Exact terms
schema.description: CSE exactTerms — phrase that must appear. cse_list / cse_siterestrict.

schema.label: Exclude terms
schema.description: CSE excludeTerms. cse_list / cse_siterestrict.

schema.label: File type
schema.description: CSE fileType. Example: pdf. cse_list / cse_siterestrict.

schema.label: Duplicate filter
schema.description: CSE filter. EXACT: 0 | 1. cse_list / cse_siterestrict.

schema.label: OR terms
schema.description: CSE orTerms — additional terms OR'd with q. cse_list / cse_siterestrict.

schema.label: Site search
schema.description: CSE siteSearch host. cse_list / cse_siterestrict. Example: example.com.

schema.label: Sort
schema.description: CSE sort expression (e.g. date). cse_list / cse_siterestrict.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact `ok` on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: cse_list, cse_siterestrict.

configurationParameters.label: Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Cx
configurationParameters.description: Programmable Search Engine ID (cx). Required. Example: 017576662512468239146:omuauf_lfve.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
